understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+', while avoiding spike tiles and completing each level within the available attempts and turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shifted the player horizontally when possible. With gravity DOWN, the player fell vertically when gaps or removed tiles allowed it. Clicking a clickable tile removed it; some clicks also caused the player to drop through the newly cleared space. Landing on a spike would end the attempt. Undo could be used to reverse an action and restore the prior state, though it was not used in the recorded turns.
